title: Stringly-Typed Configuration and State
pattern: Using a `String` primitive to represent an internal closed set of states, categories, or options.
why_bad: It is prone to silent spelling errors (e.g., passing `"REQEUSTED"` instead of `"REQUESTED"`) which will compile without issue but fail silently or trigger incorrect paths at runtime.
detection: Matching struct fields named `state`, `status`, `role`, or `type` that are typed as raw strings.
